name: direct-banking
description: Direct Banking — personal direct-debit, income, expenditure and cashflow management. Records and forecasts money; it never moves it.

scripts.build: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm -C packages/shared run build && pnpm -C packages/web run build && pnpm -C packages/server run build && pnpm run copy:web
scripts.dev: pnpm run prisma:generate && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm -C packages/server run dev" "pnpm -C packages/web run dev"
